keyDates.text: Common App 2026-2027 cycle opens for Class of 2031 applicants. Essay prompts unchanged from prior year.
Earnings accountability provisions of ED's STATS rule take effect for Direct Loan program institutions.
FAFSA opens for 2027-2028 aid year. New RAP repayment plan becomes available for post-July 2026 borrowers.
ED, EA, and REA deadlines for most selective universities including Brown ED, Harvard REA, and Stanford REA.
Deadline for final OBBBA regulations to take effect for FY2027-28 award year.
Regular Decision and ED II deadlines for most Ivy League and peer institutions.
End of FY2026. Unspent congressionally approved research funds expire and return to U.S. Treasury if not disbursed.
Brown Danoff Life Sciences Laboratories (300,000 sq ft) targeted completion. Largest academic lab building in Rhode Island.

charts.title: Estimated Annual Endowment Tax Bills Under OBBBA (AEI Estimates)
charts.linkText: Read full AEI endowment tax analysis
charts.footnote: 8% rate applies to endowments above $2M per enrolled student. Brown, Penn, Duke, and Emory remain at 1.4% and are not subject to higher-tier taxation.

charts.title: International Graduate Enrollment Decline, Spring 2026 vs. Prior Year
charts.sourceText: Higher Ed Dive citing National Student Clearinghouse Research Center, June 2026
charts.linkText: Read the state of international enrollment in 6 charts
charts.footnote: NAFSA survey of ~200 colleges found an average of 19% fewer new international master's program enrollees vs. the prior year. 84% of surveyed institutions cited restrictive visa policies as a significant challenge.

charts.title: Federal Grad Loan Caps for New Borrowers Effective July 1, 2026
charts.sourceText: U.S. Department of Education Fact Sheet, May 2026
charts.linkText: Read ED Fact Sheet on OBBBA loan changes
charts.footnote: Grad PLUS loans eliminated for all new borrowers. Legacy provision allows students who borrowed before July 1, 2026 to continue under prior rules for up to 3 years. Parent PLUS capped at $20,000/year, $65,000 lifetime.
